title: D4 Read-Only Runtime Allowlist
description: Closed execution boundary. Auditors read sanitizedRoot plus operator-pinned Python full-runtime trees, optional pinned Git, and the exact external verifier config/adapter closure needed to freshly authenticate post-P0 transition provenance. Python executable, DLL/shared-library dependencies, encodings, and stdlib are all manifested; executable lies inside a root. No PATH/current-directory/project DLL discovery. Installed skill is exposed only through rehashed _policy_runtime copies.

operatorRuntimePinId.description: ID of a d4RuntimePins entry in the separately supplied operator config. Receiver exact-compares and rehashes that external entry; this local ID/path set is not trusted by itself.

gitExecutable.description: Must exact-match the named external d4RuntimePins entry. Null requires git-current-facts disabled in the sanitized P0 config. If enabled, this is non-null and compiled argv uses this absolute pin, never PATH.

provenanceVerifierConfig.description: Exact operator-managed provenance verifier config outside project/skill. It transitively pins adapter/signature executable, adapter/support artifacts, trust anchor, and library roots. Post-P0 validation reads only this file and that closure; project config, PATH lookup, sibling imports, and unpinned environment are forbidden.

readOnlyLibraryRoots.description: Must exactly equal the named external d4RuntimePins complete Python runtime roots. At least one contains pythonExecutable. Only receiver-defined OS trust-root dependencies may load outside; any other unpinned library/module lookup fails.

policyRuntimeRoot.description: Project-relative immutable path equal to sanitizedRoot/_policy_runtime.

policyRuntimeFiles.description: Exact transitive closure of required validator and d4_preflight entrypoints, local imports, schemas, and configs. capsulePath bytes/hash must equal installed sourcePath bytes/hash.

digestSha256.description: SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps({operatorRuntimePinId, pythonExecutable, gitExecutable, provenanceVerifierConfig, readOnlyLibraryRoots sorted by path, policyRuntimeRoot, policyRuntimeFiles sorted by capsulePath}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).

path.description: Absolute operator-controlled path outside project, capsule, and installed skill.

pythonPin.description: Externally pinned Python binary/version. -B prevents pycache writes, -S disables site packages, -E ignores PYTHON* environment variables, and -X utf8 fixes text encoding.

libraryRoot.description: Exact external config match. Manifest is canonical UTF-8 {files:[sorted unique closed {path,bytes,sha256}]} outside libraryRoot/project/skill; paths are relative regular files and symlink/junction/reparse/special/escape entries fail. Receiver rehashes manifest and full tree before use.

sourcePath.description: Path relative to the installed skill root.
